relic_catalog.name: War of the Philippines TCG Relics

relic.name: Kalayaan Banner
relic.subTitle: Standard of the Revolution
relic.passive: Allied units on adjacent tiles gain +1 DEF.
relic.lore: A crimson banner carried through smoke and rain, turning scattered resistance into a single cause.

relic.name: Arnis of the Ancestors
relic.subTitle: Close-Quarter Discipline
relic.passive: Physical attacks gain +1 damage against wounded enemies.
relic.lore: Every strike carries the memory of generations who trained with wood, steel, and patient precision.

relic.name: Agimat of Protection
relic.subTitle: Inherited Ward
relic.passive: Negates the first weather ailment applied to the bearer.
relic.lore: A talisman passed from hand to hand, keeping fear and hostile spirits from crossing the bearer’s shadow.
